title: Token SLI telemetry playbook and multi-region failover runbook
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reproducible playbook and concrete instrumentation spec for token-level SLIs, plus a multi-region failover runbook and dashboard layout. This ticket bundles: 1) token SLI metric naming, aggregation, and alert thresholds; 2) dashboard panels for golden signals with token-level breakdowns; 3) circuit breaker and load-shedding telemetry; 4) an operational failover runbook (DNS, routing, and safe rollback steps) and automated synthetic probes to validate failover paths.
background: We have several ad-hoc dashboards that show per-request latencies and regional failover events, but teams report gaps when diagnosing token-level regressions (KL divergence, KV cache churn) and during cross-region failovers. Existing tickets (ENG-12037, ENG-11021) standardized SLI math but left an operational playbook missing. This work aims to make token SLIs actionable for on-call and SREs and to provide clear instrumentation to support automated fallback and load shedding decisions.

instrumentation_spec: Metric: runtime.token_generation_ms (Histogram) - Unit: milliseconds - Aggregation: histogram buckets with exemplar traces - Labels: model, model_variant, region, route, customer_tier, request_type (chat|completion|embed)
Metric: runtime.tokens_emitted_total (Counter) - Unit: count - Labels: model, region, route - Use to compute per-token error rates and throughput-normalized indicators
Metric: runtime.kv_cache_hit_total (Counter) & runtime.kv_cache_miss_total (Counter) - Unit: count - Labels: model, region, cache_namespace
Metric: runtime.request_rejected_total (Counter) - reason label: [queue_full, circuit_open, rate_limit, auth] - Use for load-shedding dashboards
Metric: runtime.circuit_breaker_state (Gauge) - 0=open, 1=half-open, 2=closed - Labels: region, model_family, policy_id
Tracing: attach span 'token_emit' per-token with tag token_index and exemplar_id for histogram linking
Synthetic probe: probe.token_synthetic_latency_ms (Gauge) - run every 30s per region/model; emits both per-probe latencies and probe-level success flag
Logging: structured log event 'failover.event' with fields {trigger, source_region, target_region, start_ts, end_ts, reason, affected_models}
sli_and_slo_definitions: Primary SLI: per-token generation latency P95 and P99 measured on runtime.token_generation_ms aggregated per model+region over 5m windows.
SLO example: 99.5% of tokens served with token_generation_ms <= 700ms (per-model baseline) and 99% for large-sequence workloads. We'll maintain per-model overrides.
Error SLI: ratio of runtime.request_rejected_total to runtime.tokens_emitted_total aggregated per hour. Target: < 0.5% for hosted tier.
Quality SLI: KV-cache hit rate (runtime.kv_cache_hit_total / (hit+miss)) with target >= 92% for latency-sensitive routes.
alert_and_circuit_policies: Paging alert: if per-model P99 token latency > 2s for 3 consecutive 1m windows -> PAGER on-call.

Auto-failover trigger: if region-wide token QoE drop (aggregate P95 increase > 2x baseline AND request_rejected_rate > 1%) for 2 consecutive 5m windows, initiate traffic diversion per failover runbook.

Circuit breaker policy: open circuit for (model,region) when request_error_rate > 5% OR token P99 > 5s for 2m. Half-open windows for 30s with limited probes, full close when metrics stabilize below thresholds.

Load shedding policy: when queue_length > configured_shard_capacity AND CPU utilization > 80%, shed non-critical routes (embedding batch jobs, low-tier customers) first, then apply early-reject to best-effort completion requests.
dashboard_layout: Top row: Golden signals overview: Token P95/P99 (global), Request error rate, Saturation indicators (GPU/CPU/queue length).
Second row: Token-latency heatmap (models x regions) with color scale indicating P99 percentiles and change from baseline.
Third row: Circuit breaker states and recent open/close events timeline; panel showing per-model shed rate and reject reasons.
Fourth row: Failover timeline and traffic diversion metrics (bytes/requests diverted), synthetic probe success rates, and runbook quick actions.
Bottom row: Recent correlated traces (linked via exemplars) and links to PRs, Confluence runbook, and incident playbook.
Permalinks: dashboard should surface a stable URL and 1-click link to create a PagerDuty incident with pre-filled context.
operational_runbook_steps: Step 0 - Triage: Confirm alert details (model, region, metric values) and check synthetic probes.
Step 1 - Short-term mitigation: Gradually divert 25% -> 50% -> 100% of non-critical traffic to target region using routing policy 'failover-v2'. Validate synthetic probes after each step.
Step 2 - Circuit breaker ops: If circuit is open for specific model, mark policy_id in dashboard, temporarily increase probe frequency to 5s for half-open checks.
Step 3 - Load shedding: If queue backlog persists, enable early-reject for best-effort routes and notify downstream customers via status page template.

Step 4 - Root cause & rollback: Inspect recent deploys, kernel selection changes, and cache eviction metrics. If deploy caused regression, rollback per release rollback checklist. If infra-related, engage infra-on-call.
Step 5 - Postmortem: Collect metrics snapshots, traces, and synthetic probe logs; open follow-up tasks to adjust SLOs or change kernel policies.
test_plan: Create staging chaos experiments that simulate regional outage and increased token P99 by injecting a 2x per-token delay in staging runtime kernel. Verify failover pipeline diverts traffic and synthetic probes detect issues within 5m.
Run load tests that saturate per-shard queue to validate load-shedding order and ensure 'request_rejected_total' labels show correct reasons.
Validate histogram accuracy by comparing exemplar-linked traces to computed percentiles in Grafana across a 24h window.
metrics_backfill_and_migration_notes: We will backfill token histograms for the last 14 days from request logs using async job 'backfill-token-hists-2026-03' to bootstrap dashboards. This job will write to 'telemetry-bootstrap' namespace.
Existing per-request latency metrics will be preserved but flagged as legacy 'deprecated_v1' in the metrics catalog. Teams must migrate dashboards within 6 weeks.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: High cardinality from many model variants & customer_tier labels causing ingest cost. Mitigation: enforce cardinality caps and rollup rules (model_family instead of variant for 1h rollups).
Risk: False positives from synthetic probes or cold-cache effects. Mitigation: mark synthetic probe metrics with 'probe=true' label and ignore for SLO calculations; use warmup window before flagging.
Risk: Alert fatigue from aggressive thresholds. Mitigation: start conservative and iterate after 2 weeks of telemetry; create non-paging alerts for gradual drift.
